description:
## 0.0.22-3 (Muthu build)

Built from Muthu1203-abi/Hushgram on HushGram 0.0.22. 202 patches for Instagram 457.0.0.55.73.

* With Run Reels behind the tab bar on, a reel's name, caption, buttons and seek bar stay above the Liquid Glass pill, and Reel seek bar position works on real reels.
* Adds Continue through liked Reels, Open developer options and Liquid Glass navigation bar.
* Fixes the two patches that failed with "SettingsStatus has no boolean method".
